notes.content:
There are now more items in the game, as space related items have been added. This is the first version of it. 

Next update some day will add some toys more,
and maybe a language, not mentioning yet which one.

notes.title: Progress save & Nordic alphabets available
notes.content:
Select your language from settings, and Letters in classroom will be in that language. Current support:
English, Finnish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian.

Play scene and the 1-5 stars are saved locally, and can be seen in the level selection room on mouse hover. Progress can be reset from the menu.
